techniques.name: Flat serve
techniques.summary: First-serve power: toss in front and right, trophy position, deep racket drop, full extension, contact high with the face square.

techniques.name: Kick serve
techniques.summary: Second serve with heavy topspin: toss above the head, brush up the back of the ball from low to high, finish to the right.

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Brush up the back of the ball

phases.name: follow_through
phases.label: Follow-through
phases.cue: Swing up and out to the right

techniques.name: Slice serve
techniques.summary: Serve with sidespin: toss further right, the racket face brushes round the outside of the ball, swing across to the left.

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Brush round the outside of the ball

techniques.name: Topspin forehand
techniques.summary: Modern forehand: big unit turn, racket drops well below the ball, low-to-high swing and a windscreen-wiper finish over the shoulder.

phases.name: forward_swing
phases.label: Racket drop
phases.cue: Lag: racket head drops below the ball

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Contact in front, low to high

techniques.name: One-handed backhand
techniques.summary: Classic one-hander: shoulders turned past side-on, free hand on the throat, contact well in front, arm extends and the chest stays sideways.

techniques.name: Two-handed backhand
techniques.summary: Both hands on the handle: compact turn, contact in front, hips and shoulders rotate through to finish over the right shoulder.

techniques.name: Slice backhand
techniques.summary: Underspin backhand: high take-back with an open face, high-to-low swing under the ball, long and low finish.

phases.name: turn
phases.label: Unit turn
phases.cue: Turn, free hand on the throat

techniques.name: Forehand volley
techniques.summary: Net volley: split step, short turn, firm wrist, punch forward with a slightly open face.

techniques.name: Backhand volley
techniques.summary: Backhand volley: free hand sets the racket, step across, block in front with an open face.

phases.name: turn
phases.label: Short turn
phases.cue: Turn, free hand on the throat

techniques.name: Overhead smash
techniques.summary: Point-ending overhead: sideways shuffle, free arm points at the lob, racket drop, full extension and drive down.

phases.name: preparation
phases.label: Turn and point
phases.cue: Turn sideways, point at the lob

techniques.name: Lob
techniques.summary: Defensive forehand lob: low-to-high, open face, lift the ball high over the net player.

techniques.name: Drop shot
techniques.summary: Disguised forehand drop shot: same take-back as a drive, then an open face slides under the ball and the swing stops short.

phases.name: forward_swing
phases.label: Racket drop
phases.cue: Racket comes from above the ball

phases.name: contact
phases.label: Contact
phases.cue: Slide under the ball, soft hands

techniques.name: Return of serve
techniques.summary: Compact forehand return: split step, short take-back, block-and-drive through the ball in front.
